maddeler.e:
انكسرت (form VII)
# اِنْكَسَرْتُ (inkasartu) /in.ka.sar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْكَسَرَ (inkasara)
# اِنْكَسَرْتَ (inkasarta) /in.ka.sar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْكَسَرَ (inkasara)
# اِنْكَسَرْتِ (inkasarti) /in.ka.sar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْكَسَرَ (inkasara)
# اِنْكَسَرَتْ (inkasarat) /in.ka.sa.rat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
